<!-- Generated by ModuleDocsGenerator from the annotations of org.hortonmachine.modules.H2cA: do not edit, change the annotations and regenerate. -->

Gives each hillslope cell the value that a map has on the network cell into which the hillslope drains. For example, with the elevation it gives the elevation of the channel each cell drains into, and its difference with the elevation is the height above the nearest drainage.

**Toolbox folder:** Hillslope<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Hillslope, Network, Attribute<br>
**Authors:** Antonello Andrea, Franceschi Silvia, Andreis Daniele, Erica Ghesla, Cozzini Andrea, Pisoni Silvano, Rigon Riccardo<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.H2cA`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inFlow` | raster file |  |  | The map of the drainage directions. |
| `inNet` | raster file |  |  | The map of the network. |
| `inAttribute` | raster file |  |  | The map whose values on the network are given to the hillslopes. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outAttribute` | output file |  | The map of the values of the network cells into which each cell drains. |
